race.comment: DO A LITTLE DANCE (2) is unlucky to still be a maiden hitting the frame in both starts to date and strikes a very winnable contest here. Drawn to get all the favours from the inside alley and should be right there when the whips are cracking. CIPHER SHOW (1) just missed the placings at Ipswich on debut before being given further time to mature. Tuned up for this with a recent trial and can run a race while fresh. BURUM BEAU (7) put in a better effort here at the latest outing and looks to be improving with racing. In the mix. IN THREE DEE (13) next best with the reliable Webster/Tilley combination.
